_comment_digest: sha256 over the episodes' canonical JSON, by episode id: one compact object per line. Canonical rather than raw bytes so the digest does not depend on line endings or formatting. Any change to an episode's content changes it, so a report can state which set it ran on.

catalog.eligibility: every ingredient has an in-stock product; 1-24 servings; at most 12 hours

labels.rule: every feasible label carries a witness week priced within its budget; every infeasible one a proof

nutrition: no episode states a nutrition target: release nutrition is not computed
review_policy: drafted in a sealed packet, then reviewed by the owner and revised on their notes until accepted
